# (APPENDIX) Appendices {-}

# Datasets used in the book {#datasets}

Every example loads its data in one chunk, labelled `data-<chapter>-<n>`, at
the start of the example. The table lists what each chunk defines. *Real*
data come with mirt; *simulated* data are generated in the chunk itself, so
the true parameters are known and the examples can check estimates against
them.

| Chunk | Data | Kind | Defines |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-measurement-1` | `SAT12`: 600 students, 32 five-option science items | Real | `raw`, `key` |
| `data-measurement-2` | 8-item wellbeing scale, 0 to 3, two negatively worded items | Simulated | `resp` |
| `data-irt-models-1` | `LSAT7`: 1,000 test takers, 5 items | Real | `resp` |
| `data-irt-models-2` | 20-item, four-option driving theory test with guessing | Simulated | `resp`, `true` |
| `data-estimation-1` | `LSAT6`: 1,000 test takers, 5 items | Real | `resp` |
| `data-estimation-2` | `SAT12`, scored with the corrected key | Real | `resp`, `key` |
| `data-dimensionality-1` | 24-item mathematics test with calculation and reading dimensions | Simulated | `resp`, `a`, `d`, `sigma` |
| `data-dimensionality-2` | 20-item reading test with a four-item passage | Simulated | `resp` |
| `data-fit-1` | `SAT12`, scored with the corrected key | Real | `resp`, `key` |
| `data-fit-2` | 30-item quiz with random responders and pre-knowledge | Simulated | `resp`, `type`, `a`, `b` |
| `data-information-1` | `SAT12`, scored with the corrected key | Real | `resp`, `key` |
| `data-information-2` | Item parameters of a 90-item nursing pool | Simulated | `pool` |
| `data-scoring-1` | `LSAT7` | Real | `resp` |
| `data-scoring-2` | 40-item mathematics test, true abilities known | Simulated | `resp`, `true_theta` |
| `data-polytomous-1` | `Science`: 392 respondents, 4 attitude items scored 1 to 4 | Real | `resp` |
| `data-polytomous-2` | 6-item job satisfaction scale, 0 to 4, one item with disordered steps | Simulated | `resp` |
| `data-dif-1` | 25-item reading test taken on paper or tablet | Simulated | `resp`, `group` |
| `data-dif-2` | 20-item chemistry quiz by gender | Simulated | `resp`, `group` |
| `data-linking-1` | Two 30-item placement forms with 10 anchors (NEAT design) | Simulated | `old`, `new`, `anchors`, `pars` |
| `data-linking-2` | The same two forms stacked for concurrent calibration | Simulated | `resp`, `form` |
| `data-banks-cat-1` | Parameters of a 200-item vocabulary bank in four areas | Simulated | `bank` |
| `data-banks-cat-2` | 300 simulated test takers for the CAT | Simulated | `true_theta` |
| `data-reporting-1` | 36-item Grade 6 science test | Simulated | `resp` |
| `data-reporting-2` | `Science` | Real | `resp` |

Table: (\#tab:datasets) Data chunks in the book and the objects each defines.

The book deliberately does not analyse the mirtverse lab datasets
(`certexam`, `numeracy`, `linking`, `catbank` and `openended`), because the
labs ask students to discover problems hidden in them. They are described in
the [teaching labs
article](https://www.okanbulut.com/mirtverse/articles/teaching-labs.html) and
on their help pages, for example `?certexam`.

## Other datasets for practice {-}

mirt ships more datasets that work well for exercises:

* `LSAT6` and `LSAT7`: short dichotomous tests (expand them with
  `expand.table()`).
* `deAyala`: five dichotomous mathematics items from de Ayala's textbook, as
  a frequency table.
* `SLF`: five dichotomous statements about social life feelings, answered by
  1,490 respondents.
* `Bock1997`: a three-item polytomous test, as a frequency table.
* `ASVAB`: four arithmetic reasoning items with response counts for four
  groups defined by sex and race, a ready-made exercise for multiple-group
  models and DIF.

Use `?<name>` for the details of each.
